title: HyCO: A Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.07990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential reinforcement learning (RL) solvers and global diffusion model (DM) solvers for neural combinatorial optimization exhibit complementary failure modes under an optimization-regret view. The former enjoys small marginal regret in the early construction stage, but suffers from horizon-wise compounding errors with super-linear regret growth; the latter avoids horizon compounding but incurs linear or sublinear regret w.r.t. the dimension of the remaining unsolved subspace. We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions. translated_title: HyCO：一种用于组合优化的混合神经求解器
translated_abstract: 在优化遗憾的视角下，用于神经组合优化的序贯强化学习（RL）求解器与全局扩散模型（DM）求解器呈现出互补的失效模式。前者在构造早期阶段具有较小的边际遗憾，但会遭受逐步累积的复合误差，导致遗憾呈超线性增长；后者虽避免了时间步上的误差复合，但其遗憾会随剩余未求解子空间的维度呈线性或次线性增长。我们提出了组合优化混合神经求解器（HyCO），这是一种混合推理算法，它先使用RL求解器构造解的前缀，再自适应地切换到条件扩散模型以完成剩余的决策。为了刻画这种混合方法为何有效、何时触发切换以及如何在实践中实现，我们首先开发了一个统一的误差缩放理论框架，并证明在明确的误差缩放假设下……
tldr: HyCO提出了一种混合推理算法，先用强化学习求解器构造解的前缀，再自适应切换到条件扩散模型完成剩余决策，并通过统一的误差缩放理论框架证明了这种混合方式能结合两类求解器的优势、规避各自的失效模式。
en_tdlr: HyCO proposes a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional diffusion model, supported by a unified error-scaling theoretical framework explaining why and when such hybridization helps in neural combinatorial optimization.
